title: Rating Manual Rule: Change in Operator Certificate Requirement Between Renewal Issue and Late Acceptance (Named Non-Owner Policy)
content:
**Rule.** The premium written for a Named Non-Owner Policy renewal term accepted after its expiring term's expiration date carries the change in the named insured's Operator certificate requirement since the renewal term was issued, which the term's recorded full-term premium does not carry. The issue date is the renewal term's opened date. The requirement is read from the named insured's filings with the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) product — form, status, requested date, required-through date and SR-26 date.

**The requirement counted.** It is an SR-22 Operator Certificate or FR-44 Operator Certificate filing of the named insured. For each form the filing read is its requested filing, otherwise its filed one, otherwise its rejected one, the one recorded first within a status, and that filing counts when its required-through date is on or after the renewal term's effective date or is not recorded; no other filing of the form is read when it does not. When both forms count, the FR-44 one counts. Withdrawn, terminated and cancellation-filed filings, Owner and Owner-Operator certificates, and the term's own record of the certificate it was written to back are not counted.

**Class of a requirement.**

| Form | 6 or more violation points | fewer than 6 violation points |
|---|---|---|
| FR-44 | 1.35 | 1.25 |
| SR-22 | 1.15 | 1.08 |

**Added class.** When the counted requirement was requested after the renewal term's issue date, its class is added. A counted requirement requested on or before the issue date is already in the recorded premium and adds nothing.

**Removed class.** When an SR-22 or FR-44 Operator certificate of the named insured that the offer carried had its SR-26 sent after the issue date, the class of its form at the named insured's violation points is removed. The FR-44 form is tested first and then the SR-22 form. For a form, the certificate read is its cancellation-filed filing recorded first and, when that one does not qualify, its terminated filing recorded first. A certificate read qualifies when it was requested on or before the issue date, its required-through date is on or after the renewal term's effective date or is not recorded, and its SR-26 date is after the issue date.

**Effect.** The change is the added class divided by the removed class, either being one when there is none; it multiplies the late-renewal written premium before that premium is rounded to the cent. With nothing added and nothing removed, no such change applies.

| Added since issue | Removed since issue | Change |
|---|---|---|
| a class | a class | added class divided by removed class |
| a class | none | the added class |
| none | a class | one divided by the removed class |
| none | none | none |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- 6 violation points, FR-44 requirement requested after the issue date, nothing removed: change 1.35. With 5 points instead: 1.25.
- 4 points, SR-22 requested after the issue date (1.08) and an FR-44 the offer carried whose SR-26 went after the issue date (1.25): change 1.08 divided by 1.25, that is 0.864.
- An SR-22 requested before the issue date and still filed: already in the recorded premium; no change.
